Primary epiphyseal bone dysplasia with joint degeneration; reported myopathy remains within the same axis.

Glycosylation defect with severe neurodevelopmental disease; liver injury 2/2, hepatitis 1/1; skeletal defects 2/3 and CK elevation 2/2; ocular findings omitted at cap.

Chemical destruction of tooth tissue; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
An immune-mediated inflammatory disorder of the anterior sclera; no additional organ involvement is established.
Congenital thumb and digital skeletal malformations; associated systemic syndromes are separate diagnoses.
Inherited hair follicle disorder causing sparse, brittle hair; eyebrow and eyelash hair abnormalities remain dermatologic.
Accommodation-related ocular misalignment; no additional organ damage is intrinsic to the condition.
Selective congenital absence of teeth; no extraoral disease is established by the supplied phenotype.
Congenital hearing/vestibular dysfunction and retinal disease define Usher syndrome; left ventricular hypertrophy in 2/5 (40%) supports cardiac involvement.
Malignant hemangiopericytoma is classified by its perivascular origin around capillaries; no specific anatomical tumor site is supplied.
